svg.title: A product page: a static shell with two holes that stream per request
svg.desc: The Ember Stove's page. The header's logo and links, the product's name and price, and the reviews are in the static shell, prerendered and cached, so they arrive at once. Two holes are filled per request: the stock line with the quantity picker, which reads fresh stock, and the cart count in the header, which reads the visitor's cookie. Each hole is a Suspense boundary whose fallback is part of the shell.
svg.text: Trailhead, Products, About plain links, the same for everyone
Ember Stove, $64.00 getProduct, cached for hours
In stock, quantity picker getStock, fresh on every request
